sample_unit: mid-stream clinical decision points from 5,535 case reports
unlisted_practices: Aligning LLMs with reinforcement learning (GRPO) and an LLM-as-a-Judge reward on mid-stream next-step clinical decisions
Supervised fine-tuning on chronologically segmented case chunks to improve next-step prediction

screen.reason: The study creates a benchmark (MedUPSQA) and proposes an alignment framework (MedUPS) to improve next-step clinical decision predictions using reinforcement learning/fine-tuning. Developing and evaluating new model architectures/alignment frameworks on benchmarks is not a deployment practice test.
